# Results (generated by train.py)

Messages after cleaning: **5158** (12.4% spam). Train: 4126, test: 1032.

## Model comparison (5-fold cross-validation on the training set)

| Model | Precision | Recall | F1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Naive Bayes | 0.992 | 0.916 | 0.952 |
| Logistic Regression | 0.970 | 0.926 | 0.947 |
| Linear SVM | 0.980 | 0.913 | 0.944 |

## Final model: Logistic Regression (C = 10), test set

| Accuracy | Precision | Recall | F1 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.989 | 0.961 | 0.953 | 0.957 |

| | Predicted safe | Predicted scam |
|---|---|---|
| **Actually safe** | 899 | 5 |
| **Actually scam** | 6 | 122 |

- 5 real messages wrongly flagged as scam (false positives)
- 6 scams that slipped through (false negatives)

## Strongest scam words

[long number], [money symbol], [link], call, call [long number], to [long number], reply, txt, text, free, mobile, tones, 150p, your, sms

## Strongest safe words

my, me, can, got, gt, am, lt, ok, that, when, he, lt gt, yup, what, then
